items.text: Service
We search and visit with you only what fits — and if needed, we renovate it too.
We search for you, visit with you, and hand you the keys.
You define what you need and we do the rest: we search, filter and visit with you only what fits. Before you decide, we study the property in depth so you buy without surprises.
And if the flat you like needs a renovation, we handle that too.
How we do it
From search to handover

items.title: Search profile
items.text: Area, type, budget and priorities: what you want and what you don't.

items.title: Active search
items.text: We scan the market according to your criteria, including off-market listings.

items.title: Selection
items.text: We only show you options that are worth a viewing.

items.title: Viewings
items.text: We organise them and accompany you with a technical eye.

items.title: Negotiation and purchase
items.text: We negotiate the price and accompany you to completion.

items.title: Renovation
items.text: If needed, we design and carry out the works so you can move straight in.
No surprises
What we review before you buy
01The propertyReal condition of the home, installations and any works with their cost.
02The buildingCondition of the building, technical inspection and planned works or community charges.
03DocumentationLand Registry note, encumbrances, habitation certificate and energy certificate.
04The priceComparison with recent sales in the area so you don't overpay.
05FinancingWith our financial broker, the mortgage studied before you commit. [See financial advice](service:asesoramiento-financiero).
06The surroundingsServices, transport, noise and neighbourhood evolution.
Renovations
Does the flat need a renovation? We handle that too.
Often the right property needs work. Instead of finding an architect, quotes and contractors on your own, we do it with the architecture and interior design studio we collaborate with.
Renovation quote before you buy, so you can decide with the full cost in hand.
Project, permits and works coordinated by us.
Timeline and finish monitoring until handover.
"Don't worry, I'll take care of it."
From the first viewing to the day you move in, you have one single adviser by your side.
Let's talk
Every good decision starts with a conversation. Let's talk about yours.
